items.source: A convenient delegate with pre-arranged configuration state for common serialization needs. Implements Serializer and Deserializer itself, so can also be passed into such more specific callback methods.
items.translation: 一种具有预配置状态的便捷委托，适用于常见的序列化需求。它实现了Serializer和Deserializer接口，因此也可以传递给此类更具体的回调方法。

items.source: Description copied from interface: Serializer
items.translation: 描述从接口复制：Serializer

items.source: Description copied from interface: Deserializer
items.translation: 描述从接口复制：Deserializer

items.source: Create a SerializationDelegate with a default serializer/deserializer for the given ClassLoader.
items.translation: 为给定的 ClassLoader 创建一个具有默认序列化器/反序列化器的 SerializationDelegate。

items.source: Create a SerializationDelegate with the given serializer/deserializer.
items.translation: 使用给定的序列化器/反序列化器创建一个SerializationDelegate。

items.source: serialize in interface Serializer<Object>
items.translation: `serialize` 在接口 `Serializer<Object>` 中

items.source: deserialize in interface Deserializer<Object>
items.translation: `deserialize` 在接口 `Deserializer<Object>` 中

items.source: serializer - the Serializer to use (never null)
items.translation: serializer - 要使用的Serializer(绝不能为null)

items.source: deserializer - the Deserializer to use (never null)
items.translation: deserializer - 要使用的Deserializer(绝不能为null)

items.source:
Note: Implementations should not close the given OutputStream
(or any decorators of that OutputStream) but rather leave this up
to the caller.
items.translation: 注意：实现不应关闭给定的 OutputStream（或其任何装饰器），而应将其留由调用者处理。

items.source:
Note: Implementations should not close the given InputStream
(or any decorators of that InputStream) but rather leave this up
to the caller.
items.translation: 注意：实现不应关闭给定的 InputStream（或其任何装饰器），而应将其留由调用者处理。

items.source: Read (assemble) an object of type T from the given InputStream.
items.translation: 从给定的 InputStream 中读取（组装）类型为 T 的对象。

items.source: Write an object of type T to the given OutputStream.
items.translation: 将类型为 T 的对象写入指定的 OutputStream。

items.source: IOException - in case of errors writing to the stream
items.translation: IOException - 在写入流时发生错误的情况下

items.source: IOException - in case of errors reading from the stream
items.translation: IOException - 在从流读取时发生错误的情况下

items.source: object - the object to serialize
items.translation: object - 要序列化的对象

items.source: outputStream - the output stream
items.translation: outputStream - 输出流

items.source: inputStream - the input stream
items.translation: inputStream - 输入流

items.source: Juergen Hoeller
items.translation: Jürgen Hoeller

items.translation: 反序列化后的对象
